evaluation.primary: candidate minus matched-control heavy-rain CSI on exactly the same paired cells in 2012-2013
evaluation.promotion: NONE; development evidence only, irrespective of the measured result

compute: CPU XGBoost, at most eight native threads, bounded local arrays, no GPU
